Definition
[Tensor components on the frame bundle] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0439, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0440 1. appf:F.2\group Frame Bundle Calculus

For a tensor $U$ of type $(p,q)$ and a frame $Y=\{ Y_a\} $, write $U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}(Y)$ for its components in $Y$. The associated vector-valued function is \[ U^\dagger :\mathcal F\mathcal M\longrightarrow \mathbb R^{n^{p+q}},\qquad U^\dagger (Y)=\bigl(U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}(Y)\bigr). \] Under $Z_b=G^a{}_bY_a$, $G\in \mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb R)$, these components obey \[ U^{a_1\cdots a_q}_{b_1\cdots b_p}(Z)= (G^{-1})^{a_1}{}_{c_1}\cdots (G^{-1})^{a_q}{}_{c_q} G^{d_1}{}_{b_1}\cdots G^{d_p}{}_{b_p} U^{c_1\cdots c_q}_{d_1\cdots d_p}(Y). \]
